insert_length.statement: forall (l1 : list nat) (n : nat), length (insert n l1) = S (length l1)
proof: induction l1 as [|a t IH]; simpl in *; repeat match goal with |- context [if ?b then _ else _] => destruct b end; simpl in *; first [lia | nia].

sort_length.statement: forall (l1 : list nat), length (sort l1) = length l1
proof: induction l1 as [|a t IH]; simpl in *; try solve [lia | reflexivity | constructor].
rewrite pt_r0_7; first [lia | reflexivity | congruence | assumption].

insert_sorted.statement: forall (l1 : list nat) (n : nat), sorted l1 -> sorted (insert n l1)
proof: induction H as [|x|x y t Hxy Ht IH]; simpl in *; repeat match goal with |- context [match ?x with _ => _ end] => let E := fresh in destruct x eqn:E end; repeat match goal with H : (_ <=? _) = true |- _ => apply Nat.leb_le in H | H : (_ <=? _) = false |- _ => apply Nat.leb_gt in H end; simpl in *; repeat match goal with |- context [match ?x with _ => _ end] => let E := fresh in destruct x eqn:E end; repeat match goal with H : (_ <=? _) = true |- _ => apply Nat.leb_le in H | H : (_ <=? _) = false |- _ => apply Nat.leb_gt in H end; first [lia | reflexivity | assumption | (repeat constructor; first [lia | assumption | eassumption]) | (constructor; [lia | assumption])].

insert_perm.statement: forall (l1 : list nat) (n : nat), Permutation (n :: l1) (insert n l1)
proof: induction l1 as [|a t IH]; simpl in *; try solve [lia | reflexivity | constructor].

repeat match goal with |- context [match ?x with _ => _ end] => let E := fresh in destruct x eqn:E end; simpl in *; first [reflexivity | (apply perm_skip; assumption) | (eapply perm_trans; [apply perm_swap | apply perm_skip; assumption])].

sorted_sort_id.statement: forall (l1 : list nat), sorted l1 -> sort l1 = l1

proof: induction IHl1 as [|x|x y t Hxy Ht IH]; simpl in *; repeat match goal with |- context [match ?x with _ => _ end] => let E := fresh in destruct x eqn:E end; repeat match goal with H : (_ <=? _) = true |- _ => apply Nat.leb_le in H | H : (_ <=? _) = false |- _ => apply Nat.leb_gt in H end; simpl in *; repeat match goal with |- context [match ?x with _ => _ end] => let E := fresh in destruct x eqn:E end; repeat match goal with H : (_ <=? _) = true |- _ => apply Nat.leb_le in H | H : (_ <=? _) = false |- _ => apply Nat.leb_gt in H end; first [lia | reflexivity | assumption | (repeat constructor; first [lia | assumption | eassumption]) | (constructor; [lia | assumption])].

sort_perm.statement: forall (l1 : list nat), Permutation l1 (sort l1)

sort_idem.statement: forall (l1 : list nat), sort (sort l1) = sort l1
